speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome. The clinical presentation of a continuous heart murmur (PDA), bluish non-blanching macules (petechiae/purpura), cloudy lenses (cataracts), and sensorineural deafness constitutes the classic triad for this condition. The request to diagnose Cellulitis is clinically inconsistent with these findings.
